dedupe_keys.name: traffic signal control benchmark datasets road networks and flows for cityflow

description: This site offers benchmark data sets for testing traffic signal control methods, including reinforcement learning controllers, because results depend strongly on the simulation environment, road network and traffic flow. Each data set has a road network file (roadnet.json) and a traffic flow file (flow.json) in the formats of the CityFlow simulator, with reference average travel times and the method that achieved them. Real-world sets are based on camera data in Hangzhou for single intersections at several sites and hours and for a 4 by 4 grid of 16 intersections, with fixed turning ratios (10 per cent left, 60 per cent straight, 30 per cent right) derived from taxi GPS statistics; synthetic sets use uniform or Gaussian arrivals on grids from 1 by 1 to 4 by 4. The site also hosts a survey of signal control methods. Coverage is small city networks. Access: free downloads from the site; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: real data were simplified because of low quality, turning ratios are fixed, and right-turning vehicles are dropped in the single-intersection sets. The data support benchmarking of signal optimisation and agent-based control. They complement the CityFlow simulator catalogued here.
